title: The Pirate's Declaration
subtitle: Don't cut off power so quick, silly! You missed that song.

trails.title: Trail ① A Rating  Sheet Left Behind
trails.description: You are surrounded by the clerks. Maybe they didn't catch your words just now.

content.text: Snacks of the New Era and the Rockin' Pirate

◎ Rigabit: Yogurt Bullets  
Pink yogurt from Michigan which pops out like a bullet.
"Not so good as I thought it would be, but does feel novel ...
Hmm, well, mmm ... 5.6 out of 10."

◎ K&K: Oatmeal Breakfast Bars
Actually a candy bar with little oatmeal.
"Not bad, I'll give it an 8."

◎ Kjeldson!!! Logger Cookies!!!
Known for the rich butter within, it has a rough flavor of the logger style which is exactly the opposite of the royal style.
"What does logger style mean, dry as sawdust?!
I will put in on the Prohibited List of my ship and it's never getting removed! 1 out of 10!"

◎Pota-ta-tato: Face Chips
There are all kinds of facial expressions. I may look the same when deep fried.
"Too many crumbs. Can't taste the flavor of potato. BARBECUE WITH MUSTARD FLAVORED ...
Well, acceptable. 4.5 out of 10."

◎ Cheetahs Cheetahs! Amazing Seeds!
Puffed snack. CHEESE SURINAME TOAD JAM FLAVORED.
"When your product is buried in soil but can't grow into anything after 3 days of watering, 24 times in total by the way, you'd better not put the word 'Seed' in its name! 0!
CHECK, OUT, THIS, BIG, ZERO!"

items.text: The Pirate's Declaration
Lobby, St. Foundation
The receptionist is confirming the name list just submitted by the House of Integratus.
The vice president is coming her way. It's rare to see her picking up the files herself.
But as the daily agenda tracker shows, the chance of the vice president asking for this name list is 85%.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Do we have the candidates' name list? Show it to me.

items.speaker: Clerk
items.text: Yes, please wait a minute. It'll be prepared right away.
That's right. Thanks to the invention designed by Laplace Scientific Computing Center, everything here is highly controllable, efficient, and has logic within.
The fingers of the receptionist lightly percuss the keyboard. She will be able to locate the files faster than ever.
Suddenly, she freezes.

items.speaker: Clerk
items.text: Um, why is the light on?
With a horrible prediction in her mind, she hesitantly turns to the wall with an open mouth and round eyes.
"Buzzz ..."
A gigantic projection appears on the wall.
An apple shows up in the blurry projection. Under such a poor resolution, it looks like a massive red alert.
A sentence in a crooked font emerges beneath that giant pixel apple .
The words are glaring, "THIS IS WAR!"

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Warning, warning! Everybody, listen up. We have taken over the Foundation!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Our demands are: release us, set Vertin free!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You have three days. After that, we are ...
The receptionist cuts off the power, terrified.
The lobby, which sees people striding in and stalking off all the time, now freezes in dead silence.

items.speaker: Clerk
items.text: Madam ... I ...

items.speaker: Clerk
items.text: I didn't ... I ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What's the matter? Something wrong with the printer?

items.speaker: Clerk
items.text: No, no ... Oh right, the candidate name list ... Here you are.
She passed on the name list with a pale face.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Thank you, this is exactly what I need.
Constantine casts a quick look at the wall.
The source of the disturbance has gone.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Sorry for the scene.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Like others here, they also have the right to make their voices heard. It is the essential step for us to come to an agreement.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We will take care of this, don't worry.
She smiles. As she does so, the people around her are visibly relieved and stored to life.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: However ... perhaps we should stop using the old projector. It may lead to accidents, don't you think?

items.speaker: Clerk
items.text: Understood! I'll remove the transfer devices now ...
She jumps up on her feet and salutes her.
Constantine turns around and leaves.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh bloody hell! How dare they cut off the power ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This Pirate has so much left to declare!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wimps! Cowards! Hypocrites!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hear, hear! I can't agree more. It is very rude to hang up before others finish their words!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This is not telephone, Ms. Sotheby.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: But of course, that's not the point.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: No matter what, we've communicated to them the most crucial requirement for negotiation.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I'm sure they will respond to us properly.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Humph ... I just wanna take the chance to show our attitude ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Taking over the radio station at the headquarters of the Foundation ... It's a gas in the late hundreds of years ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *sighs* It would've been perfect if we could have another You Can't Win to close it out.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: We could look around here to see if there's other broadcasting equipment.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: However, this APPLe does not recommend frequent provocation.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Right now it's more important to patrol the surroundings in case we are ambushed by the guards.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ms. Druvis is forming abatis alone downstairs. Perhaps she needs our help.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Mmm ... Fine, you have a point.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This Pirate ... has decided to put off the plan to liberate the Foundation!
Almost reluctantly, she forces herself to stop looking at the radio.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Besides forming abatis, what else do we need to do?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: There's much to be done, Captain.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Find water sources. Transfer essential equipment. Reserve enough food. Set up multiple defenses in the woods.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: And arrange a duty schedule. Make sure someone is garrisoned outside the suitcase, while others are resting inside.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Well, I have the tomato and potato seeds from Ms. Druvis. We must plant them in the suitcase to guarantee food supply!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Um ... Tomato and potato ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: All vegetables, no meat … they're meant for the piggies that grow my bacon.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: When I was wandering the seas, at least I could have a grilled sea bass every day ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *sighs* I wonder what Vertin eats in rehab ... Will she be hungry ...
"Grrrr ..."

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oooh! Almost forgot about the goodies X sent!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: We'll definitely hang in there for a few more days with them!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Sotheby, Mr. APPLe, you go downstairs first. I'll meet up with you once I bring the box down there!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Alright! We will meet you at the entrance. Stay safe!
TO BE CONTINUED…
The Pirate's Declaration
Beetles Ballroom
At night, they make their way through a secret passage beneath the hotel, traveling through layers of earthwork before arriving at an underground club.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Hey!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: I found us a new friend!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Make that two new friends.
Regulus steps into the scene with her trademark flair.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So, this is your hideout?

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Well, yeah. It's not much, just an old stage. All that's left of an old speakeasy from a long time ago.
She gestured toward the performance area behind her.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: It's not bad, except for the lighting, and the air down here can get stuffy.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: But hey, it's somewhere to practice without those thugs breathing down our necks.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: You said you were some kind of Radio DJ back in the car, right? So you know music.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Miss Riley, when it comes to music, the Captain's taste is world-class!

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: Is that a talking apple?
The band takes immediate interest in the appearance of the floating apple.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Too right he is! He's the first and best mate of my crew!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Oh yeah, well, I guess it's time our crews met—
Riley presents her bandmates with electrifying showmanship.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: You've met Four-Finger Johnny on bass, and on guitar we've got the rockadelic Flash Lianna, hitting the drums we've got Warhammer Uni, and lastly on those electric ivories we've got Octopus Dmitry.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: And me—I sing.
With introductions out of the way, the newcomers are welcomed into their circle.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: We're planning to record our own album and then distribute it to the people in town secretly.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Here—
She presents their music in a very unusual format.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa!
A stack of used x-ray film.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: X-ray film!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You're recording music on these?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: That's quite the unusual technique.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: You got it, sister. It's a trick we picked up from our Ruskie friend, Dmitry.
Not far away, Dmitry, busy tuning his keyboard, nodded in acknowledgment.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Apparently, back in Russia, they had to sneak in American music on these "bone discs."

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Metal as hell, don't you think?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Bang on, mate. But, let's get down to business.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Why bother with old x-rays when we could just take over the Broadcast Theater?
Regulus pitches a curveball to her American friends.
The only noise that follows comes from the soft circling motion of the stage lights.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oi, mates! Did I rock your brains out with that or something?
She adjusts her sunglasses before launching into her proposal.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Cutting records and distributing them ... It's all fine, yeah, but what'll it really accomplish?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Why not really make some noise?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Head right down to the belly of the beast and put a show on that'll blast them into the stratosphere!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Now that's how a real rockin' pirate rolls!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, I feel I must offer a bit of caution. You're proposing quite a risky venture.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Gotta agree with the apple; I don't think I—we're prepared to do something so ... crazy.
The rest of the band grumbles out similar apprehensions.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: C'mon, gang! Picture it—a pirate radio special here in Gold Dust!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: We'll crank up the volume and blast our sound straight through their ban-happy skulls.

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: What, so, like, we just storm in waving our instruments in the air and mosh our way through to the stage?

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: Then hijack their mics to sing all those songs they don't want us to hear?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Sharp as a tack you are, Johnny.
The bassist stops for a moment before a wide wolfish grin stretches out over his face.

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: Metal! I'm in—I'm so in. What about you, Riley?
The bassist picks up his weapon of rock and plays an expectant riff.
The drums join in, followed by the keyboard.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: Getting tired of playing underground, aren't you, Riley? Let's hit a new venue.
Riley stands on stage, looking out over her friends as they sign on with the rockin' pirate's proposal, feeling their eyes lingering on her.

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Sing? In front of ... everyone? I don't know ... I don't think I'm ready.

items.speaker: Enforcer I
items.text: This must be the place!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: The hell!? How'd they find us?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Sounds like we've got uninvited guests.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Jackbooted censors!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I guess we'll have to give them a little preview, hard rock style!
The defeated enforcers are tied up with rope and tossed over to the edge of the stage.

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: Are we sure this is a good idea? Are these ropes gonna hold them?

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: Relax, these ropes are plenty thick. They used them for the curtains, I think, back when this place had curtains.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But how did they find us here?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Could it be the letter, Captain?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Huh, you mean this old thing?
APPLe doesn't answer directly, instead looking over the letter intently.

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: A letter?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I'm beginning to form a connection here, Captain.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The mayor offered us this invitation back on the street. He said it was from the Order of Enlightenment, but something about it gave off an eerie sort of feeling.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I do believe the ominous nature of this letter wasn't just unease but arcanum!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Cor! But why're they so bothered with us?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Just because we didn't want to register with them?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The absolute cheek! Thinking they could put their stamp on us!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I might tolerate the Foundation tracking me, but these half-pence peelers? Not on your life!

items.speaker: Riley
items.text: See, this is why I was worried. We need to burn that letter and scatter while we can.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No. Because we're gonna bring that letter right down to their little theater and walk in like we own the place!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: They want to bug me, eh? Well, what's more rock 'n' roll than barging into their stronghold with their own tracker in hand?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Get a move on; we've got a theater waiting for a show!
She turns to the tied-up guards.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Try those ropes as much as you like, lads. By the time you're free, this town will be rocking out to a new kind of hymn.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: C'mon. We've got the gig of a lifetime ripe for the taking!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain ...

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: I'm ready to rock, Captain.
Her crew grows one by one.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: Is life even worth living if you can't make a little trouble?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Too right! We're not just going to flip them the bird; we're going to shove it right in their faces!

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: That's one hell of a way to put it!
She raises her guitar up like a sword, joining the Regulus's growing crew.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: I always knew I had what it takes to be a pirate. Even though I can't swim.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: The captain's right, folks—
She turns to her fellow bandmates.

items.speaker: Flash Lianna
items.text: And after the show, we'll follow up with a revolution!

items.speaker: Four-Finger Johnny
items.text: Speaking of revolutions, Lianna, I've got another great idea!
The "crew" buzzes with excitement, their plans and music echoing through the underground club.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, I do believe they think we're actual pirates.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hah! Aren't we?
She grabs the microphone—though it wasn't yet powered—and issues her first order.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Alright, crew, grab your gear.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Let's set sail! Our destination: The Broadcast Theater!
